label: Item Presets
description: Edit item spawns from inside the game (in warmup) and keep layouts per map as presets for balance tests. A preset is a diff against the vanilla map, stored in the host's Redis; with no active preset a restart gives the map's own layout.

commands.name: item
commands.description: Edits the items of this map where the caller stands: add spawns one, remove/replace take the nearest one, move picks it on the first call and places it on the second. Types: rl lg rg pg sg gl mg cg ng pl hmg bfg, ra ya ga shard, mh 50hp 25hp 5hp, quad bs haste invis regen or a classname.

commands.name: preset
commands.description: Presets of the current map. save stores the current edits and makes them active, load activates one and restarts, off restarts with the vanilla layout.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the editor and the active preset on. With 0 the commands refuse and no preset is applied on restarts.

cvars.label: Permission
cvars.description: Permission level for !item and !preset. Read when the plugin loads.

cvars.label: Pick radius
cvars.description: How far (game units) from the caller !item remove/replace/move look for the nearest item.
